paragraphs.source_en: Okō changed Chōan into his nightclothes, by which time he was already snoring loudly.

units.source_en: Okō changed Chōan into his nightclothes, by which time he was already snoring loudly.
units.source_zh: 阿幸替长安换上睡衣，长安已鼾声大作了。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan cared greatly about his appearance and kept his face clean-shaven. Okō pinched his cheek, twisting his normally well-shaped lips until they brought a snakehead fish to mind. It suddenly occurred to her that his hide might be thicker even than a snakehead's, so she gauged its thickness with her fingertips.

units.source_en: Chōan cared greatly about his appearance and kept his face clean-shaven.
units.source_zh: 长安是个重仪表之人，脸上的胡须刮得干干净净。

units.source_zh: 阿幸突然想，说不定他脸皮比鳢鱼还要厚，遂用指尖比量他脸皮。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安是个重仪表之人，脸上的胡须刮得干干净净。阿幸捏住他的脸颊，原本端正的嘴唇扭曲了，让人想起鳢鱼。阿幸突然想，说不定他脸皮比鳢鱼还要厚，遂用指尖比量他脸皮。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan slept peacefully, his breathing now even. Okō took her hand away, lay beside him, and pressed her face against his.

units.source_en: Chōan slept peacefully, his breathing now even.
units.source_zh: 长安睡得安详，呼吸也匀了。

units.source_en: Okō took her hand away, lay beside him, and pressed her face against his.
units.source_zh: 阿幸拿开手，躺在他旁边，把脸贴上去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安睡得安详，呼吸也匀了。阿幸拿开手，躺在他旁边，把脸贴上去。

paragraphs.source_en: Okō began to toy with Chōan's right ear. Why did people have ears? Perhaps so they would remember what they themselves had said. Okō sat up, brought her mouth to Chōan's ear, and blew a forceful stream of warm breath into it.

units.source_en: Okō began to toy with Chōan's right ear.
units.source_zh: 阿幸开始玩弄长安的右耳。

units.source_en: Why did people have ears?
units.source_zh: 人为何会长耳朵？

units.source_en: Perhaps so they would remember what they themselves had said.

ja.t: れぬためかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 恐是为了让人记住自己的话。

units.source_en: Okō sat up, brought her mouth to Chōan's ear, and blew a forceful stream of warm breath into it.
units.source_zh: 阿幸坐起身，把嘴伸到长安耳边，用力将温暖的气息往里一吹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿幸开始玩弄长安的右耳。人为何会长耳朵？恐是为了让人记住自己的话。阿幸坐起身，把嘴伸到长安耳边，用力将温暖的气息往里一吹。

paragraphs.source_en: “Mm, mm, mm.” Chōan squirmed, scratched his ear, and muttered softly, “Okō, I know it's you.” He murmured as though talking in his sleep, then drew up his legs and slept on.

units.source_en: “Mm, mm, mm.”
Chōan squirmed, scratched his ear, and muttered softly, “Okō, I know it's you.”
units.source_zh: 长安扭了扭身子，挠了挠耳朵，小声咕哝道，“阿幸，我知是你。”

units.source_en: He murmured as though talking in his sleep, then drew up his legs and slept on.

ja.t: のようにそうつぶやくと、また

units.source_zh: 他像是在说梦话，喃喃着，又蜷腿睡着了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “嗯，嗯，嗯。”长安扭了扭身子，挠了挠耳朵，小声咕哝道，“阿幸，我知是你。”他像是在说梦话，喃喃着，又蜷腿睡着了。

paragraphs.source_en: Okō chuckled to herself. Chōan probably considered Okō a plaything well suited to him. Yet to Okō, Chōan too was a body she never tired of playing with. Stroking Chōan's body, Okō soon fell asleep as well.

units.source_en: Okō chuckled to herself.
units.source_zh: 阿幸独自嘿嘿笑了起来。

units.source_en: Chōan probably considered Okō a plaything well suited to him.
units.source_zh: 长安大概觉得，阿幸乃是一个适合他的玩物。

units.source_en: Yet to Okō, Chōan too was a body she never tired of playing with.

ja.t: は、いつまでももてあそんで

units.source_zh: 然而，对于阿幸，长安亦是一具让她总也把玩不厌的肉身。

units.source_en: Stroking Chōan's body, Okō soon fell asleep as well.
units.source_zh: 阿幸抚摸着长安的身体，不久也睡去了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿幸独自嘿嘿笑了起来。长安大概觉得，阿幸乃是一个适合他的玩物。然而，对于阿幸，长安亦是一具让她总也把玩不厌的肉身。阿幸抚摸着长安的身体，不久也睡去了。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan's decision to take Okō to Sado was bound up with his ambition. He meant to transform the little island whose gold and silver only he could unearth into a paradise without equal under heaven, leaving all who saw it gaping in astonishment.

units.source_en: Chōan's decision to take Okō to Sado was bound up with his ambition.
units.source_zh: 长安决定把阿幸带到佐渡，此举包含着他的野心。

units.source_en: He meant to transform the little island whose gold and silver only he could unearth into a paradise without equal under heaven, leaving all who saw it gaping in astonishment.
units.source_zh: 他想把那个只有他才能发掘出金银的小岛，建成天下独一无二的极乐世界，让人为之瞠目。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安决定把阿幸带到佐渡，此举包含着他的野心。他想把那个只有他才能发掘出金银的小岛，建成天下独一无二的极乐世界，让人为之瞠目。

paragraphs.source_en: If that scheme succeeded, the man with the most gold and silver in Japan would not be the shogun, but Ōkubo Chōan! The gold and silver delivered to the shogunate would meet the country's expenses, while once production grew beyond reckoning, Chōan could freely dispose of twenty percent of it—perhaps even more.

units.source_en: If that scheme succeeded, the man with the most gold and silver in Japan would not be the shogun, but Ōkubo Chōan!
units.source_zh: 倘若此方能成，那么，在日本拥有金银最多的并非将军，而是大久保长安！

units.source_en: The gold and silver delivered to the shogunate would meet the country's expenses, while once production grew beyond reckoning, Chōan could freely dispose of twenty percent of it—perhaps even more.
units.source_zh: 向幕府缴纳的金银，要作国家用度，而金银产量多得难以计算时，长安可自由支配其中两成，甚至还多。

paragraphs.source_zh: 倘若此方能成，那么，在日本拥有金银最多的并非将军，而是大久保长安！向幕府缴纳的金银，要作国家用度，而金银产量多得难以计算时，长安可自由支配其中两成，甚至还多。

paragraphs.source_en: Suppose a mine that had produced only one thousand ryō increased its yield tenfold, to ten thousand. If, with a little manipulation, the remittance of eight hundred ryō were raised to three thousand, Ieyasu himself would gain an additional twenty-two hundred ryō, while Ōkubo Chōan's total income could rise to seven thousand. Chōan had no intention of taking all that gold for himself, yet if he wished, he could effortlessly adorn the whole island of Sado with gold and silver.

units.source_en: Suppose a mine that had produced only one thousand ryō increased its yield tenfold, to ten thousand. If, with a little manipulation, the remittance of eight hundred ryō were raised to three thousand, Ieyasu himself would gain an additional twenty-two hundred ryō, while Ōkubo Chōan's total income could rise to seven thousand.
units.source_zh: 设若本来产量只有一千两的地方增加十倍，便是一万两，若稍作手脚，八百两的缴纳额增为三千两，那么，家康自己可以增收两千二百两，大久保长安的总入则可以增至七千两。

units.source_en: Chōan had no intention of taking all that gold for himself, yet if he wished, he could effortlessly adorn the whole island of Sado with gold and silver.

units.source_zh: 长安并不想将那么些黄金据为己有，而只要他愿意，他甚至可不费吹灰之力，将佐渡岛用金银装饰一遍。

paragraphs.source_zh: 设若本来产量只有一千两的地方增加十倍，便是一万两，若稍作手脚，八百两的缴纳额增为三千两，那么，家康自己可以增收两千二百两，大久保长安的总入则可以增至七千两。长安并不想将那么些黄金据为己有，而只要他愿意，他甚至可不费吹灰之力，将佐渡岛用金银装饰一遍。

paragraphs.source_en: Most important of all, Sado was cut off from the mainland, a desolate island in the open sea. If anyone failed to understand Chōan and sought to call him to account, he could swiftly take refuge on the island and hire rōnin to defend him.

units.source_en: Most important of all, Sado was cut off from the mainland, a desolate island in the open sea.
units.source_zh: 最重要的是，佐渡不与陆地相连，乃是大海中的一个荒岛。

units.source_en: If anyone failed to understand Chōan and sought to call him to account, he could swiftly take refuge on the island and hire rōnin to defend him.
units.source_zh: 万一有人无法理解长安，要求追究他的过错，他自可迅速隐匿到这岛上，雇佣浪人自卫。

paragraphs.source_zh: 最重要的是，佐渡不与陆地相连，乃是大海中的一个荒岛。万一有人无法理解长安，要求追究他的过错，他自可迅速隐匿到这岛上，雇佣浪人自卫。

paragraphs.source_en: The queen bee must not become infatuated with a little bee. She must not dote on the little bee too much, but neither could she neglect him. She would make Chōan drunk with her in body and soul: she was the other half of the shell destined for him—lying beside Chōan, Okō let her thoughts wander.

units.source_en: The queen bee must not become infatuated with a little bee.
units.source_zh: 蜂王不可迷恋小蜂。

units.source_en: She must not dote on the little bee too much, but neither could she neglect him. She would make Chōan drunk with her in body and soul: she was the other half of the shell destined for him—lying beside Chōan, Okō let her thoughts wander.

ja.t: になりすぎてはいけないが、
っておくわけにもいかない。

units.source_zh: 虽不能过于迷恋，但也不可把小蜂置之不顾，她要让长安因她身心俱醉：她便是他命中的另一半贝壳——阿幸陪在长安身边，浮想联翩。

paragraphs.source_zh: 蜂王不可迷恋小蜂。虽不能过于迷恋，但也不可把小蜂置之不顾，她要让长安因她身心俱醉：她便是他命中的另一半贝壳——阿幸陪在长安身边，浮想联翩。

paragraphs.source_en: Just as the eastern sky began to pale, Ōkubo Chōan and Okō entwined themselves together.

units.source_en: Just as the eastern sky began to pale, Ōkubo Chōan and Okō entwined themselves together.
units.source_zh: 东方刚刚泛出鱼肚白时，大久保长安和阿幸纠缠到了一起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 东方刚刚泛出鱼肚白时，大久保长安和阿幸纠缠到了一起。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan claimed to have conquered a thousand women, yet before Okō he was no more than a pitiable little bee.

units.source_en: Chōan claimed to have conquered a thousand women, yet before Okō he was no more than a pitiable little bee.
units.source_zh: 长安声称过去曾征服过一千个女人，但他在阿幸面前，不过一只令人生怜的小蜂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安声称过去曾征服过一千个女人，但他在阿幸面前，不过一只令人生怜的小蜂。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan said that a woman like Okō could exist only because Lord Nobunaga's march to Kyoto had brought peace to the realm, aided also by the late Taikō, Ieyasu, and others, and that they must therefore be thanked. But to Okō, none of that had anything to do with her. She slipped free of every bond and came and went as she pleased, easy in both body and spirit.

units.source_en: Chōan said that a woman like Okō could exist only because Lord Nobunaga's march to Kyoto had brought peace to the realm, aided also by the late Taikō, Ieyasu, and others, and that they must therefore be thanked.

ja.t: くしたおかげであるから、

units.source_zh: 长安说，世上能出现阿幸这等女子，皆因信长公上洛之后，天下得以太平，亦多亏了已故太阁和家康等人，故必须感谢他们。

units.source_en: But to Okō, none of that had anything to do with her.

ja.t: にとって、そんなことは

units.source_zh: 但对于阿幸，这些和她全无关系。

units.source_en: She slipped free of every bond and came and went as she pleased, easy in both body and spirit.
units.source_zh: 她挣脱束缚，身心舒畅地来去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安说，世上能出现阿幸这等女子，皆因信长公上洛之后，天下得以太平，亦多亏了已故太阁和家康等人，故必须感谢他们。但对于阿幸，这些和她全无关系。她挣脱束缚，身心舒畅地来去。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan was certainly no mean man, but she could not prostrate herself at his feet and serve him heart and soul. A little bee, after all, had to work. In Chōan's eyes, Okō had to remain a gorgeous, sweet-scented flower seldom found in this world, one that would keep him longing for her.

units.source_en: Chōan was certainly no mean man, but she could not prostrate herself at his feet and serve him heart and soul.
units.source_zh: 长安确实不赖，然而她不能拜倒在他脚下，全心全意侍奉他。

units.source_en: A little bee, after all, had to work.
units.source_zh: 既然身为小蜂，就得劳作。

units.source_en: In Chōan's eyes, Okō had to remain a gorgeous, sweet-scented flower seldom found in this world, one that would keep him longing for her.

ja.t: きつけねばならなかった。

units.source_zh: 阿幸在长安眼里，必须是世间罕有的、香气扑鼻的艳丽花朵，让他留恋。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安确实不赖，然而她不能拜倒在他脚下，全心全意侍奉他。既然身为小蜂，就得劳作。阿幸在长安眼里，必须是世间罕有的、香气扑鼻的艳丽花朵，让他留恋。

paragraphs.source_en: “Heaven rejoiced at the peace, and from the sixth year of Keichō onward gold began to flow in abundance.” So everyone said, but it was surely Chōan who had first spread the saying.

units.source_en: “Heaven rejoiced at the peace, and from the sixth year of Keichō onward gold began to flow in abundance.”
units.source_zh: “上天感于太平，自庆长六年，始多产黄金。”

units.source_en: So everyone said, but it was surely Chōan who had first spread the saying.
units.source_zh: 世人都这般说，但最初散布这个说法的，定是长安无疑。

paragraphs.source_zh: “上天感于太平，自庆长六年，始多产黄金。”世人都这般说，但最初散布这个说法的，定是长安无疑。

paragraphs.source_en: Sado Island itself remained desperately poor. It was a small island yielding only twelve thousand koku and had formerly served as a place of exile for criminals. Now that Chōan was transporting great numbers of laborers there, it was only natural that the necessities of life should grow scarcer still.

units.source_en: Sado Island itself remained desperately poor.
units.source_zh: 佐渡岛本身至今贫乏不堪。

units.source_en: It was a small island yielding only twelve thousand koku and had formerly served as a place of exile for criminals. Now that Chōan was transporting great numbers of laborers there, it was only natural that the necessities of life should grow scarcer still.
units.source_zh: 此岛乃是一个只有一万二千石的小岛，先前用作流放罪人之地，但长安如今往这里运送了大量劳役，生活之资愈是贫乏，亦是理所当然。

paragraphs.source_zh: 佐渡岛本身至今贫乏不堪。此岛乃是一个只有一万二千石的小岛，先前用作流放罪人之地，但长安如今往这里运送了大量劳役，生活之资愈是贫乏，亦是理所当然。

paragraphs.source_en: The coastal people had originally eked out a poor living by farming and fishing, but they were later conscripted time and again as miners. Though the place was surrounded by sea, even fish had now become hard to obtain. Chōan therefore went out of his way to summon fishermen from Iwami and settle them around Himezu, between Aikawa and Kitajebisu.

units.source_en: The coastal people had originally eked out a poor living by farming and fishing, but they were later conscripted time and again as miners.

ja.t: らしをしていたが、のちには

units.source_zh: 原来海边诸民过着半耕半渔的生活，甚是贫困，后来几度被征为矿工。

units.source_en: Though the place was surrounded by sea, even fish had now become hard to obtain.

ja.t: まれているというのに、

units.source_zh: 此处虽然四面环海，如今却连鱼也难得吃上。

units.source_en: Chōan therefore went out of his way to summon fishermen from Iwami and settle them around Himezu, between Aikawa and Kitajebisu.
units.source_zh: 于是，长安特意从石见招来渔民，让其定居于相川和北狄之间的姬津一带。

paragraphs.source_zh: 原来海边诸民过着半耕半渔的生活，甚是贫困，后来几度被征为矿工。此处虽然四面环海，如今却连鱼也难得吃上。于是，长安特意从石见招来渔民，让其定居于相川和北狄之间的姬津一带。

paragraphs.source_en: In short, Chōan had forcibly awakened Sado Island from the silence and solitude it had enjoyed amid the sea, bored holes into its body, and made it disgorge gold.

units.source_en: In short, Chōan had forcibly awakened Sado Island from the silence and solitude it had enjoyed amid the sea, bored holes into its body, and made it disgorge gold.
units.source_zh: 总之，长安强行唤醒了这个在海中享受着寂静与孤独的佐渡岛，在它身体上挖开洞穴，让它往外吐出黄金。

paragraphs.source_zh: 总之，长安强行唤醒了这个在海中享受着寂静与孤独的佐渡岛，在它身体上挖开洞穴，让它往外吐出黄金。

paragraphs.source_en: With so many people suddenly flooding the island, the imbalance between men and women became severe. Edo had experienced the same thing, but Sado's predicament was far worse than Edo's had been. Laborers from Aikawa went as far as the Hamochi region in search of women; the rape and murder of commoners' wives occurred from time to time, and disturbances broke out everywhere.

units.source_en: With so many people suddenly flooding the island, the imbalance between men and women became severe.
units.source_zh: 岛上突然拥入这么些人，男女比例大大不谐。

units.source_en: Edo had experienced the same thing, but Sado's predicament was far worse than Edo's had been.
units.source_zh: 江户虽也出现过此种情形，但佐渡所面临的困境远远大于江户当年。

units.source_en: Laborers from Aikawa went as far as the Hamochi region in search of women; the rape and murder of commoners' wives occurred from time to time, and disturbances broke out everywhere.
units.source_zh: 相川的劳役甚至到羽茂一带去找女人，奸杀百姓家室之事亦时有发生，各处骚乱不断。

paragraphs.source_zh: 岛上突然拥入这么些人，男女比例大大不谐。江户虽也出现过此种情形，但佐渡所面临的困境远远大于江户当年。相川的劳役甚至到羽茂一带去找女人，奸杀百姓家室之事亦时有发生，各处骚乱不断。

paragraphs.source_en: Ōkubo Chōan had told Okō none of this. He merely rhapsodized about how, on an island of gold where women were scarce, women would be doted upon by the men, filling them with excitement.

units.source_en: Ōkubo Chōan had told Okō none of this.
units.source_zh: 大久保长安绝未向阿幸提起这些。

units.source_en: He merely rhapsodized about how, on an island of gold where women were scarce, women would be doted upon by the men, filling them with excitement.
units.source_zh: 他只是鼓吹，在一个女人稀缺的黄金岛上，女人将会如何受到男人们的宠爱，令她们激动不已。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大久保长安绝未向阿幸提起这些。他只是鼓吹，在一个女人稀缺的黄金岛上，女人将会如何受到男人们的宠爱，令她们激动不已。

paragraphs.source_en: “Remember this: when the miners arrive, they will take off their worn straw sandals. Treasure those sandals and wash them carefully. The gold washed from them alone will amount to a whole sack of gold dust every year.” What would the god of Sado Island say if it heard such words?
